text_block_list.text:
Having left something behind during yesterday's training,
I headed back to the track to retrieve it—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
I wiiin~♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh!
And here I thought I had it this time~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Geez! Next time, I'm definitely gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
Invite me again next time, okay~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Trainer!
What're you doing here so early?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what would you call it?
Nurturing our friendship? Something like that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"There was this girl who ran really well in a race recently,
so I tried calling out to her—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey!
You ran in that race the other day, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That's true, but what about you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm Tokai Teio!
The Umamusume who's gonna become
the 'Undefeated Empress' and surpass the 'Emperor'!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I thought your late charge back then was incredible!
Won't you race against me too?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, pleeease!
It's gonna be a super fun match, I swear♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
I can't believe... I lost...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that was so much fun~♪
Just as I thought, it was a great match!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Could you please not make it sound
like breaking a sweat is refreshing!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
In that case... you have to race me again next time!
I won't let this end with just 'that was fun'!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Huh!
Sounds good, count me in!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided...
let's deepen our friendship with an after-party♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
On the track, everyone's a rival!
Off the track, everyone's a friend, as they say♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I've never heard of anything like that before...iacute;?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Yay, let's do it!
Let's go eat a mini parfait together at the cafeteria~♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey?!
Don't pull me~~~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And like that, we started challenging each other
whenever we had free time~.
choice_data_list: Is training not enough for you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And like that, we started challenging each other
whenever we had free time~.
choice_data_list: Is training not enough for you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No. I'm doing it because it's fun!
It's so thrilling to race against strong opponents, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I became good friends with her,
and we even hang out together sometimes now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I get to race, and I made new friends!
Everything's going great, isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay!
Something like this isn't enough to tire me out!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm running on dirt~.
I can't wait for race day~♪

The presence of a new friend seems to have
a positive influence on Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The other day, they taught me the trick
to breaking out of the pack during a race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I forgot the little details, but... you go whoosh in,
zoom right through, and then BAM! Like that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Like, whoosh, swish, and zoom!
Ah, I wanna try that out in my next race~♪

I couldn't fully comprehend the tips she talked about,
but...

The presence of a new friend seems to have
a positive influence on Tokai Teio.
